Dear Sir: Will you be so kind as to notice this work in your paper, and send marked copy to Yours Fraternally,
L. F. Baum, Syracuse, N. Y.

A COMPLETE LIST OF ALL DEALERS IN THE
UNITED STATES, TOGETHER WITH THE
PRINCIPAL ONES OF EUROPE,

COMPILED AND PUBLISHED BY

SYRACUSE:
HITCHCOCK & TUCKER, PRINTERS AND BINDERS.
1873.

div.head: PREFACE.
div.p: In presenting this little book to our friends, we wish to offer a few words of explanation. Many Directories have been commenced, but none ever published. We have taken great care to procure the addresses of every prominent dealer in the United States, and we think that few have been omitted. Of course, where dealers are constantly starting business, and others retiring, to produce a complete Directory would be impossible, but we have taken every measure to make the work as perfect as possible.

L. FRANK BAUM,
WM. NORRIS,
H. C. BAUM.

Note.—Mr. S. A. Taylor,† 81 Washington Street, Boston, is a dealer, but does not want his name included in this work, so we omit him.
